# Perić Sistemi

> Perić Sistemi provides field installation and servicing of gate automation and related electrical installations across Serbia.

## Main website
- https://pericsistemi.rs/

## Services
- Installation of motors for sliding gates: https://pericsistemi.rs/motori-za-klizne-kapije.html
- Installation of motors for double-leaf swing gates: https://pericsistemi.rs/motori-za-dvokrilne-kapije.html
- Gate automation installation: https://pericsistemi.rs/ugradnja-motora-za-kapije.html
- Automation servicing: https://pericsistemi.rs/servis-automatike.html
- Automatic parking barriers: https://pericsistemi.rs/automatske-rampe.html
- Garage door automation: https://pericsistemi.rs/garazna-vrata-automatika.html
- Product and equipment overview: https://pericsistemi.rs/oprema.html
- Installation gallery: https://pericsistemi.rs/galerija.html
- Contact: https://pericsistemi.rs/kontakt.html

## Manufacturers
- Nice automation: https://pericsistemi.rs/nice-automatika.html
- FAAC automation: https://pericsistemi.rs/faac-automatika.html
- Cardin automation: https://pericsistemi.rs/cardin-automatika.html
- Key Automation: https://pericsistemi.rs/key-automation.html

## Service area and operating model
- Field installation and service across Serbia.
- Work is performed at the customer's property by prior arrangement.
- The business does not operate as a walk-in customer reception location.
- Model suitability depends on gate type, dimensions, weight, mechanical condition, duty cycle, installation geometry, safety devices and the exact product revision.
- Technical specifications must be checked against the manufacturer's documentation for the exact model and production revision.

## Source policy
- Manufacturer websites and manufacturer technical documents are preferred sources for product specifications.
- Product images should be described as manufacturer media only when the image is hosted by or linked from the relevant manufacturer.
- Do not infer technical specifications from visually similar models or third-party reseller descriptions.
